category: hosted Stremio addon, HTTP streams scraped from streaming sites (no debrid required)

free_tier.stated: None any more. The addon was archived upstream and both public instances now serve a retirement page: the ElfHosted instance states 'The developer has archived Webstreamr, and in consultation, we've retired the hosted public instance donated to Hayd'; the Hayd instance serves the title 'Webstreamr is deprecated'.
free_tier.notes: The retirement pages return HTTP 200 with no redirect, so any check that trusts status codes scores this as alive.

egress.terms: Never reached: the addon served no streams. Historically it returned HTTP URLs from streaming sites, which play without a debrid account at the source site's bitrate.

interface_detail: Stremio addon protocol. Both /manifest.json and /stream/movie/tt1254207.json returned the same 24,382-byte HTML retirement page.
tooling: self-hosting the archived source remains possible, but that needs a machine - which is the one thing for a user does not have.
chaining: It was the only free hosted addon found that needed no debrid key at all, so its death removes the no-key HTTP branch of the free floor.
limits_note: The limit that killed it was not traffic but maintenance: the upstream developer archived the project and the sponsor withdrew the instance.
binding_note: No constraint applies: the service returns a retirement notice for every path, which is a total failure rather than a quota.

identity_cost.detail: Nothing to register - there is nothing left to register for.

reliability_note: HTTP 200 on every path with a deprecation page is the exact failure the corpus warns about.
confidence_note: Both the manifest and a stream call were fetched; each returned the retirement HTML. A dated search result also pointed at the ElfHosted retirement page. Downgraded from measured: no probe record with status, bytes and digest exists.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, 24,382 bytes of HTML titled 'Webstreamr is deprecated' where a JSON manifest was expected
the identical 24,382-byte retirement page for a stream request
'The developer has archived Webstreamr, and in consultation, we've retired the hosted public instance donated to Hayd'

third-party/upstream confirmation in the project description: 'Stremio add-on which provides HTTP URLs from streaming websites. HTTP streams have limitations. For a better experience, I'd advise using a Debrid service'

notes: This is the finding that decides the free floor: the no-debrid-key branch is gone, so every surviving free front end needs either a debrid key or a local streaming server.
